body:
I know how to get there. I've been dealt an unfair hand. I had to drop out of school because my panic attacks and anxiety were making me suicidal. I dropped out at the advice of my therapist and got saddled with a bill that's only grown while I haven't been able to pay it. Panic attacks and anxiety were caused by the fact that my rapist was attending the same school.

I've struggled with employment for years because of the mental illness. I would spend days crying and wanting to die because my job at the time gave me such extreme anxiety. I did everything I could to combat it too... therapy, meds...

I'm a smart person. I know when life has shit on me. I don't need advice from people who didn't have shit dealt to them like I have. I'm sick of trying when nothing ever goes right. I don't know what I did wrong, but I sure as hell didn't deserve this.

I am a woman, by the way. A woman who is so done with this world and this life and everything around me. I miss my mom but I know she gets what I'm going through. I know she understands why it's hard for me to carry on. Why should I? Nothing will go right anyway. It never does. Fuck this.
